11	type StartConfig = SpawnConfig

13	
14	// ---- Logger ----
15	
16	export interface Logger {
17	  debug(msg: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): void
18	  info(msg: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): void

24	  debug() {},
25	  info() {},
26	  warn() {},
27	  error() {},
28	}

30	// ---- Session ----
31	
32	interface Session {
33	  log: EventLog
34	  process: ProcessHandle | null
35	  runId: string | null
36	  resumeId: string | null
37	  lastConfig: StartConfig | null
38	}
39	
40	// ---- Config ----
41	
42	export interface SessionManagerOptions {
43	  logger?: Logger
44	  maxLogSize?: number
45	  /** Pluggable storage backend for event persistence. When provided,
46	   *  events survive server restarts and in-memory eviction. */
47	  storage?: EventStorageAdapter
48	  onEvent?: (event: SessionEvent) => void
49	}
50

52	
53	export interface SessionDiagnostics {
54	  status: Status
55	  activity: Activity
56	  runId: string | null
57	  resumeId: string | null
58	  processAlive: boolean
59	  pid: number | undefined

62	  lastEventType: EventType | null
63	  subscriberCount: number
64	}
65	
66	// ---- Kill escalation timings ----
67	
68	const SIGTERM_DELAY_MS = 3000
69	const SIGKILL_DELAY_MS = 5000
70	
71	// ---- SessionManager ----
72	
73	export class SessionManager {
74	  private sessions = new Map<string, Session>()
75	  private adapter: ProcessAdapter
76	  private logger: Logger
77	  private maxLogSize: number
78	  private storage: EventStorageAdapter | null
79	  private onEvent?: (event: SessionEvent) => void
80	
81	  constructor(adapter: ProcessAdapter, options?: SessionManagerOptions) {
82	    this.adapter = adapter
83	    this.logger = options?.logger ?? noopLogger
84	    this.maxLogSize = options?.maxLogSize ?? 2000
85	    this.storage = options?.storage ?? null
86	    this.onEvent = options?.onEvent
87	  }
88	
89	  async start(sessionId: string, config: StartConfig): Promise<{ runId: string; processId?: string }> {
90	    let session = this.sessions.get(sessionId)
91	    if (!session) {
92	      session = {
93	        log: new EventLog({ maxSize: this.maxLogSize, storage: this.storage ?? undefined }),
94	        process: null,
95	        runId: null,
96	        resumeId: null,
97	        lastConfig: null,
98	      }
99	      this.sessions.set(sessionId, session)
100	    }
101	
102	    if (session.process?.alive) {
103	      const currentStatus = deriveStatus(session.log.all())
104	      if (currentStatus === 'idle') {
105	        // Process alive in keep-alive mode after turn completed — kill it before respawning
106	        this.logger.info('Killing idle keep-alive process before restart', { sessionId })
107	        session.process.signal('SIGTERM')
108	        await Promise.race([
109	          session.process.exited,
110	          new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5000)),
111	        ])
112	        session.process = null
113	      } else {
114	        throw new Error('Session already has an active process')
115	      }
116	    }
117	
118	    const runId = crypto.randomUUID()
119	    session.runId = runId
120	    session.lastConfig = config
121	
122	    this.appendEvent(session, 'run:start', { config }, runId, sessionId)
123	    this.logger.info('Starting session', { sessionId, runId })
124	
125	    let handle: ProcessHandle
126	    try {
127	      handle = await this.adapter.spawn(config)
128	    } catch (err) {
129	      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
130	      this.appendEvent(session, 'run:error', { message, code: 'SPAWN_FAILED' }, runId, sessionId)
131	      this.logger.error('Spawn failed', { sessionId, runId, error: message })
132	      throw err
133	    }
134	
135	    session.process = handle
136	    this.logger.info('Process spawned', { sessionId, runId, pid: handle.pid })
137	
138	    // Record the user's prompt after spawn succeeds (not before, so spawn
139	    // failures don't record phantom input).
140	    if (config.prompt) {
141	      this.appendEvent(session, 'input:sent', { text: config.prompt }, runId, sessionId)
142	    }
143	
144	    this.pipeEvents(session, handle, runId, sessionId)
145	    this.handleExit(session, handle, runId, sessionId)
146	
147	    return { runId, processId: handle.processId }
148	  }

150	  async stop(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
151	    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId)
152	    if (!session?.process?.alive) return
153	
154	    const status = deriveStatus(session.log.all())
155	    if (status === 'stopping') return
156	
157	    this.appendEvent(session, 'stop:requested', {}, session.runId!, sessionId)
158	    this.logger.info('Stop requested', { sessionId })
159	
160	    const process = session.process
161	
162	    // Escalating kill: SIGINT → (if unresponsive) SIGTERM → SIGKILL
163	    // SIGINT asks the CLI to cancel the current turn. If it responds (turn:end
164	    // → status becomes idle), the process stays alive for future messages.
165	    // Only escalate to SIGTERM/SIGKILL if the CLI doesn't respond in time.
166	    process.signal('SIGINT')
167	    this.logger.debug('Sent SIGINT', { sessionId })
168	
169	    setTimeout(() => {
170	      if (!process.alive) return
171	      // If the CLI responded to SIGINT (turn:end arrived after stop:requested),
172	      // don't kill it — it's alive and ready for the next message.
173	      // We check for turn:end directly rather than deriveStatus because late-
174	      // arriving content events from the cancelled turn can make deriveStatus
175	      // return 'streaming' even though the turn already ended.
176	      const events = session.log.all()
177	      let stopIdx = -1
178	      for (let i = events.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
179	        if (events[i].type === 'stop:requested') { stopIdx = i; break }
180	      }
181	      const turnEndAfterStop = stopIdx >= 0 && events.slice(stopIdx).some((e: { type: string }) => e.type === 'turn:end')
182	      if (turnEndAfterStop) {
183	        this.logger.debug('CLI responded to SIGINT (turn:end after stop:requested), skipping SIGTERM', { sessionId })
184	        return
185	      }
186	      process.signal('SIGTERM')
187	      this.logger.debug('Sent SIGTERM (escalation)', { sessionId })
188	      setTimeout(() => {
189	        if (process.alive) {
190	          process.signal('SIGKILL')
191	          this.logger.debug('Sent SIGKILL (final escalation)', { sessionId })
192	        }
193	      }, SIGKILL_DELAY_MS - SIGTERM_DELAY_MS)
194	    }, SIGTERM_DELAY_MS)
195	  }

197	  async send(sessionId: string, input: string): Promise<void> {
198	    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId)
199	    if (!session) throw new Error('Unknown session')
200	
201	    const status = deriveStatus(session.log.all())
202	
203	    if (status === 'starting') {
204	      throw new Error('Cannot send while starting')
205	    }
206	    if (status === 'stopping') {
207	      throw new Error('Cannot send while stopping')
208	    }
209	
210	    if (status === 'idle' && !session.process?.alive) {
211	      if (!session.lastConfig) {
212	        throw new Error('Session config not available')
213	      }
214	      // Process exited after last turn — spawn new run with input as prompt
215	      this.logger.info('Spawning new run for follow-up', { sessionId })
216	      const config: StartConfig = {
217	        ...session.lastConfig,
218	        prompt: input,
219	        ...(session.resumeId ? { resume: session.resumeId } : {}),
220	      }
221	      await this.start(sessionId, config) // returns { runId, processId } — unused here
222	      return
223	    }
224	
225	    // Process alive — write to stdin
226	    session.process!.write(input + '\n')
227	    this.appendEvent(session, 'input:sent', { text: input }, session.runId!, sessionId)
228	    this.logger.info('Input sent', { sessionId, inputLength: input.length })
229	  }
230	
231	  getStatus(sessionId: string) {
232	    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId)
233	    if (!session) return 'idle' as const
234	    return deriveStatus(session.log.all())
235	  }

237	  /**
238	   * Recover a session from storage after a server restart.
239	   * Creates an in-memory session with a storage-backed EventLog but no process.
240	   *
241	   * If the session was mid-stream when the server died, a synthetic `run:end`
242	   * is injected so the session derives as idle. We can't reconnect to a
243	   * running process after restart, so honest idle is better than a stuck
244	   * streaming indicator with no live event pipe.
245	   *
246	   * Returns the EventLog if recovery succeeded, null if no storage or no events.
247	   */
248	  recoverFromStorage(sessionId: string): EventLog | null {
249	    if (!this.storage) return null
250	    if (this.sessions.has(sessionId)) return this.sessions.get(sessionId)!.log
251	
252	    const count = this.storage.count(sessionId)
253	    if (count === 0) return null
254	
255	    const log = new EventLog({ maxSize: this.maxLogSize, storage: this.storage, sessionId })
256	
257	    // Read tail events to recover session context and check status.
258	    const tailEvents = this.storage.read(sessionId, {
259	      beforeSeq: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
260	      limit: 50,
261	    })
262	
263	    // Recover resumeId and lastConfig from stored events.
264	    let resumeId: string | null = null
265	    let lastConfig: StartConfig | null = null
266	    for (let i = tailEvents.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
267	      if (!resumeId && tailEvents[i].type === 'run:ready') {
268	        const data = tailEvents[i].data as { resumeId?: string }
269	        if (data.resumeId) resumeId = data.resumeId
270	      }
271	      if (!lastConfig && tailEvents[i].type === 'run:start') {
272	        const data = tailEvents[i].data as { config?: StartConfig }
273	        if (data.config) lastConfig = data.config
274	      }
275	      if (resumeId && lastConfig) break
276	    }
277	
278	    // If the session was interrupted mid-stream, close it cleanly.
279	    const status = tailEvents.length > 0 ? deriveStatus(tailEvents) : 'idle'
280	    if (status !== 'idle') {
281	      const lastEvent = tailEvents[tailEvents.length - 1]
282	      log.append(
283	        'run:end',
284	        { reason: 'server_restart', code: null },
285	        lastEvent.runId,
286	        sessionId,

291	      })

294	    const session: Session = {

3	// ---- Status ----

5	export type Status = 'idle' | 'starting' | 'streaming' | 'stopping'
6	
7	export function deriveStatus(events: readonly SessionEvent[]): Status {
8	  for (let i = events.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
9	    switch (events[i].type) {
10	      case 'run:end':
11	      case 'run:error':
12	      case 'turn:end':
13	        return 'idle'
14	      case 'stop:requested':
15	        return 'stopping'
16	      case 'content':
17	      case 'result':
18	        return 'streaming'
19	      case 'input:sent':
20	        // During a fresh spawn, input:sent is recorded before the CLI boots
21	        // (it's the prompt being passed to the process, not actual user input
22	        // during an active session). Check whether run:ready has been seen
23	        // since the last run:start — if not, the CLI hasn't booted and we're
24	        // still in the starting/spawning phase.
25	        for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
26	          if (events[j].type === 'run:ready') return 'streaming'
27	          if (events[j].type === 'run:start') return 'starting'
28	        }
29	        return 'streaming'
30	      case 'run:ready':
31	        // During a fresh spawn, run:ready means "CLI just booted" — but if
32	        // input:sent was already recorded (the prompt), the CLI is about to
33	        // process it. Return streaming so there's no idle flash between
34	        // spawning and the first content event.
35	        for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
36	          if (events[j].type === 'input:sent') return 'streaming'
37	          if (events[j].type === 'turn:end' || events[j].type === 'run:end') return 'idle'
38	          if (events[j].type === 'run:start') return 'idle'
39	        }
40	        return 'idle'
41	      case 'run:start':
42	        return 'starting'
43	    }
44	  }
45	  return 'idle'
46	}

49	
50	export type Activity =
51	  | { type: 'thinking' }
52	  | { type: 'tool'; name: string; input?: unknown }
53	  | null

55	// ---- Process liveness ----
56	
57	/**
58	 * Derives whether the CLI process is alive from the event log.
59	 *
60	 * This is distinct from `deriveStatus` which tracks what the process is *doing*.
61	 * A process can be idle (between turns) but still alive in keep-alive mode.
62	 * `deriveStatus` returns 'idle' for both `turn:end` (alive) and `run:end` (dead).
63	 * This function distinguishes the two.
64	 */
65	export function deriveProcessAlive(events: readonly SessionEvent[]): boolean {
66	  for (let i = events.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
67	    switch (events[i].type) {
68	      case 'run:end':
69	      case 'run:error':
70	        return false
71	      case 'run:start':
72	      case 'run:ready':
73	      case 'content':
74	      case 'result':
75	      case 'input:sent':
76	      case 'turn:end':
77	      case 'stop:requested':
78	        return true
79	    }
80	  }
81	  return false
82	}

87	  const status = deriveStatus(events)
88	  if (status !== 'streaming') return null
89	
90	  for (let i = events.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
91	    const e = events[i]
92	    if (e.type === 'content') {
93	      const blocks = (e.data as { blocks?: ContentBlock[] }).blocks
94	      if (!blocks || blocks.length === 0) continue
95	      const lastBlock = blocks[blocks.length - 1]
96	      if (lastBlock.type === 'thinking') return { type: 'thinking' }
97	      if (lastBlock.type === 'tool_use')
98	        return { type: 'tool', name: lastBlock.name, input: lastBlock.input }
99	    }
100	    if (e.type === 'turn:end') return null
101	  }
